blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing 3D large language models often overlook fine-grained attributes and less visually salient objects and parts, even when relevant evidence is present in scene videos. We introduce Lens3D to improve fine-grained object understanding through external visual assistance and knowledge transfer. Its LensUnd pipeline adopt 3D localization to select informative, complementary views for an external 2D vision-language model, supporting fine-grained object captioning, small-object grounding, and fine-grained object question answering. And its LensDistill transfers the resulting fine-grained knowledge to 3D LLMs through detailed caption supervision, enabling captioning from native inputs without external VLM calls. We also construct LensBench , a held-out evaluation set of 2,068 objects with three silver-standard reference descriptions per object. Experiments with Video-3D LLM and 3DRS demenstrate that LensDistill substantially improves fine-grained object captioning while preserving existing grounding and scene-level QA performance. These results establish the feasibility of transferring externally acquired fine-grained knowledge into native 3D LLMs.
blocks.zh: 现有的3D大语言模型往往忽略了精细的特质和不太显眼的物体和部分,即使现场视频中存在相关证据. 我们引入了Lens3D,通过外部视觉协助和知识转让来提高精细的受精对象理解. 它的LensUnd管道采用3D本地化,为外部的2D视觉语言模型选择信息化,互补的视图,支持精细的物体标题,小物体地平面,精细的物体问题回答. 它的LensDistill通过详细的字幕监管,将由此产生的精致知识转移到了3D LLM,从而可以在没有外部VLM调用的情况下从本地输入中进行字幕. 我们还建造了Lens Bench, 一套被搁置的评价, 由2,068个物体组成, 每个物体有三个银-标准参考说明。 与Video-3D LLM和3DRS解码器的实验,LensDistill在保留现有的地平面和场景级QA性能的同时,大幅度地改进了精细的地平面物体字幕. 这些结果确定了将外部获得的精细知识转移到本地3D LLM的可行性.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Lens3D brings fine-grained object understanding to 3D LLMs. While existing models capture broad scene structure and salient objects (left), Lens3D further capture instance-level attributes and easily overlooked small objects (right), with the performance radar showing these gains in fine-grained understanding do not come at the cost of the models’ original grounding and question-answering abilities (center).
blocks.zh: 图1: Lens3D为3D LLMs带来了精细的物体理解. 虽然现有的模型捕捉了广义的场景结构和突出物体(左),Lens3D进一步捕捉到实例级属性和容易被忽略的小物体(右),而性能雷达显示这些在精细分辨上的增益并不以模型最初的地平分和问答能力(中)为代价.

blocks.en: 1.  Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Recent 3D large language models (3D LLMs), such as Video-3D LLM [ 43 ] and 3DRS [ 23 ] , have advanced 3D scene understanding. However, they often overlook fine-grained object attributes, as well as less visually salient objects and parts (Figure 1 , left). For example, a model may locate an overhead cabinet yet struggle to identify its door material or handle orientation. These details matter for embodied interaction: handle orientation can affect a robot’s grasping pose and manipulation strategy. Reliable scene understanding therefore requires both locating objects and recognizing their fine-grained properties.
blocks.zh: 近期的3D大语言模型(3D LLM),如Video-3D LLM [43]和3DRS [23],已推进了3D场景理解. 然而,它们往往忽略了细纹对象属性,也忽略了视觉不太明显的物体和部件(图1,左方). 例如,一个模型可能会找到一个高通柜,但却难以确定其门材或处理取向。 这些细节对于体现的相互作用很重要:处理方向可以影响机器人的把握姿势和操纵策略. 因此,可靠的场景理解要求确定物体的位置并承认其精细的特性。

blocks.en: High-resolution scene videos often contain the necessary visual evidence, but two factors limit its utilization. First, existing 3D datasets emphasize object categories, referring expressions, and short descriptions, providing limited supervision for fine-grained attributes [ 13 , 5 , 11 ] . Second, relevant details may not be visually salient, and their visibility varies across viewpoints. Even when captured in the video, these details may be difficult for a model to distinguish from the surrounding content and use for the task. Together, these challenges motivate more effective utilization of the available visual evidence and richer supervision for fine-grained understanding.
blocks.zh: 高清场景视频经常包含必要的视觉证据,但有两个因素限制了其使用. 首先,现有的三维数据集强调对象类别,引用表达式,和简短描述,对细纹属性提供有限的监督[13,5,11]. 第二,有关细节可能不具有视觉特征,其能见度因观点而异。 即便在视频中捕获到这些细节,对于一个模型来说可能难以区分周围的内容和任务用途. 这些挑战共同促使人们更有效地利用现有的可视证据,并进行更丰富的监督,以进行精细的理解。

blocks.en: Recent work on 2D vision-language models (VLMs) shows the value of focusing on informative image regions for closer inspection [ 45 , 4 ] . Inspired by this principle, we exploit 3D localization to guide evidence selection across video frames. Our framework, Lens3D , combines externally assisted fine-grained understanding with knowledge transfer to 3D LLMs. Its external understanding pipeline, LensUnd , uses a 3D LLM to locate the object or region relevant to a query, such as the cabinet containing the handle of interest. It then selects clear, complementary views from the input video. An external 2D VLM examines these focused evidences to perform fine-grained object captioning, small-object grounding, or fine-grained object question answering (QA). This connects existing 3D grounding capabilities with fine-grained 2D perception.
blocks.zh: 最近关于2D视觉语言模型(VLMs)的研究表明,注重信息化图像区域以进行更深入的检查[45,4]是有价值的. 基于这一原则,我们利用3D本地化来指导跨视频帧的证据选择. 我们的框架Lens3D结合了外部援助的精细理解和向3D LLMs的知识转让. 它的外接理解管道LensUnd 使用3D LLM定位与查询相关的对象或区域,例如包含兴趣处理的柜子. 然后从输入视频中选择清晰,互补的视图. 外部的2D VLM 检查这些有重点的证据,以进行精细的物体标题,小物体地平,或精细的物体问题回答(QA). 这把现有的3D地基能力与精细的2D感知联系起来.

blocks.en: Beyond external assistance, we ask whether the resulting knowledge can be transferred to the 3D LLM itself. To this end, we introduce LensDistill , which uses LensUnd as a teacher through asymmetric privileged-information distillation [ 12 ] . We study this transfer through fine-grained object captioning, which provides supervision for materials, parts, states, and spatial relationships. The teacher accesses the selected visual evidence, while the student learns to generate detailed descriptions from its native inputs. After distillation, the student performs captioning without additional view processing or external VLM calls.
blocks.zh: 除了外部援助外,我们询问由此产生的知识是否可以被转移到3D LLM本身. 为此,我们介绍LensDistill ,通过不对称特权信息分解[12],将LensUnd作为教师. 我们通过精细的物体标题来研究这种转移, 它对材料、部件、状态和空间关系进行监督。 老师获取所选的视觉证据,而学生则学习从其本土投入中生成详细的描述. 蒸馏后,学生在不进行额外视图处理或外部VLM呼叫的情况下进行字幕.

blocks.en: Evaluating this capability requires references that capture instance-level details, which existing captioning benchmarks cover sparsely. We therefore construct LensBench , a held-out evaluation set of 2,068 objects with three independently generated VLM descriptions per object. A questionnaire-based quality audit supports their use as silver-standard references. Experiments with two representative 3D LLMs, Video-3D LLM and 3DRS, show that LensDistill substantially improves fine-grained object captioning, reaching performance comparable to a similarly sized 2D VLM while preserving existing grounding and scene-level QA performance (Figure 1 , right and center). Qualitative results further illustrate LensUnd’s utility for small-object grounding and fine-grained object QA. Our contributions are: • We introduce LensUnd , which uses 3D localization to better exploit visual details already present in scene videos. With an external 2D VLM, it supports fine-grained object captioning, small-object grounding, and fine-grained object QA. • We propose LensDistill and demonstrate that detailed caption supervision can transfer externally acquired object knowledge to 3D LLMs. This improves fine-grained object captioning without external VLM calls at inference, while preserving existing grounding and scene-level QA performance. • We construct LensBench , covering 2,068 objects with three silver-standard reference descriptions per object. These references support evaluation of instance-level attributes that are sparsely covered by existing 3D captioning benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 评估这种能力需要参考书目,收集实例一级的细节,而现有的标题基准涵盖的很少。 因此,我们构建了Lens Bench, 一套被搁置的、由2,068个物体组成的评估,每个物体有三个独立生成的VLM描述. 基于问卷的质量审计支持将其作为银 -- -- 标准参考。 由两个具有代表性的3D LLMs,Video-3D LLM和3DRS的实验显示,LensDistill大幅度地改进了细纹对象字幕,在保持现有地平面和场景级QA性能(图1,正中和正中)的同时达到与类似大小的2D VLM相仿的性能. 定性结果进一步说明了LensUnd对小物体地基和细纹物体QA的效用. 我们的贡献是: • 我们引入了LensUnd,它使用3D本地化来更好地利用现场视频中已经存在的视觉细节. 它使用外置的2D VLM,支持精细的物体标题,小物体地平面和精细的物体QA. 我们提议LensDistill,并证明详细的字幕监督可以将外部获得的物体知识转移到3D LLMs. 这改善了细纹对象字幕,没有外部的VLM调用推断,同时保留了现有的地基和场景级QA性能. ^ 我们构建了Lens Bench,覆盖了2,068个对象,每个对象有三个银标准参考描述. 这些参考文献支持对现有3D字幕基准很少覆盖的例级属性的评价.

blocks.en: We introduce LensUnd , which uses 3D localization to better exploit visual details already present in scene videos. With an external 2D VLM, it supports fine-grained object captioning, small-object grounding, and fine-grained object QA.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍LensUnd, 使用3D本地化, 它使用外置的2D VLM,支持细纹对象标题,小纹对象地平面,和细纹对象QA.

blocks.en: We propose LensDistill and demonstrate that detailed caption supervision can transfer externally acquired object knowledge to 3D LLMs. This improves fine-grained object captioning without external VLM calls at inference, while preserving existing grounding and scene-level QA performance.
blocks.zh: 我们提议LensDistill,并证明详细的字幕监督可以将外部获得的物体知识转移到3D LLMs. 这改善了细纹对象字幕,而无需外部VLM调用推断,同时保留了现有的地基和场景级QA性能.

blocks.en: We construct LensBench , covering 2,068 objects with three silver-standard reference descriptions per object. These references support evaluation of instance-level attributes that are sparsely covered by existing 3D captioning benchmarks.

blocks.en: 2.  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 3D scene understanding
blocks.zh: 2.1 三维场景理解

blocks.en: 3D scene understanding spans object detection, semantic and instance segmentation, and language-conditioned tasks such as grounding, captioning, and question answering. ScanRefer [ 5 ] , ReferIt3D [ 1 ] , and Multi3DRefer [ 41 ] study 3D target localization from natural-language expressions, while 3DVG-Transformer [ 42 ] , BUTD-DETR [ 24 ] , and EDA [ 34 ] improve grounding through cross-modal scene modeling. Scan2Cap [ 11 ] introduced 3D dense captioning; D3Net [ 6 ] and Vote2Cap-DETR [ 9 ] subsequently advanced joint grounding and end-to-end captioning, respectively, and PQ3D [ 47 ] uses promptable queries to unify multiple 3D vision–language tasks. ScanQA [ 2 ] and SQA3D [ 26 ] further evaluate scene-level spatial reasoning. These tasks and datasets, however, primarily emphasize object categories, and spatial relations, with limited coverage of fine-grained object details.
blocks.zh: 3D场景理解跨越对象检测,语义和实例分解,以及语言条件化的任务,如地平线,字幕和问答等. Scan Refer [5], ReferenceIt3D [1],和Multi3Drefer [41] 从自然语言表达法研究了3D目标本地化,而3DVG-Transfer [42],ButD-DETR [24],以及EDA [34]通过跨模式的场景建模改进了地面. Scan2Cap [11] 引入了3D稠密字幕; D3Net [6] 和 Vote2Cap-DETR [9] 之后分别推进了联合地取地和端到端字幕,而PQ3D [47] 使用可快速查询来统一多个3D视觉-语言任务. ScanQA [2]和SQA3D [26] 进一步评价场景级空间推理. 然而,这些任务和数据集主要强调对象类别和空间关系,对细纹对象细节的覆盖范围有限.

blocks.en: 2.2 3D large language models
blocks.zh: 2.2 三维大语言模型

blocks.en:
3D large language models connect 3D scene representations with pretrained language models to support grounding, description, question answering, and even generation within a unified framework. For 3D understanding, 3D-LLM [ 17 ] , Chat-3D [ 33 ] , LL3DA [ 8 ] , and LEO [ 20 ] explore different interfaces between point clouds, object tokens, and language models, while LLaVA-3D [ 44 ] augments multiview 2D features with 3D spatial information. Beyond understanding, ShapeLLM-Omni [ 36 ] and CG-MLLM [ 21 ] extend 3D multimodal models toward unified understanding and generation, enabling them to both reason about and synthesize 3D content.
However, incorporating 3D perception into pretrained language models typically requires additional 3D encoders or alignment modules, limiting their ability to directly inherit the rich knowledge of large-scale pretrained models. Video-based approaches provide an alternative by representing multiview 3D observations as video, allowing them to directly exploit the strong visual and temporal understanding capabilities of pretrained models.Video-3D LLM [ 43 ] treats multiview indoor observations as video and injects 3D positional encodings, while 3DRS [ 23 ] further introduces explicit 3D representation supervision. Despite these increasingly capable architectures and their access to rich multimodal observations, existing 3D LLMs remain constrained by datasets that emphasize categories, spatial relations, and other coarse supervision [ 13 , 5 , 11 ] . Consequently, their understanding remains coarse, with limited training signal for fine-grained object details and small, easily overlooked objects.
blocks.zh:
3D大语言模型将3D场景表现与预先训练的语言模型相接,支持地平面,描述,提问回答,甚至在一个统一的框架内生成. 为3D理解,3D-LLM [17],Chat-3D [33],LL3DA [8],和LEO [20]探索点云,对象符和语言模型之间的不同接口,而LLaVA-3D [44]则用3D空间信息来增强多视图2D特性. 除了理解外,ShapeLLM-Omni[36]和CG-MLLM[21]扩展了3D多模式模式,以达到统一的理解和生成,使其既能解释又能合成3D内容.
然而,将3D感知融入被预先训练的语言模型通常需要额外的3D编码器或对齐模块,限制了他们直接继承大规模被预先训练模型的丰富知识的能力. 基于视频的方法通过将多视图三维观测作为视频来表示,从而提供了一种替代方法,使其能够直接利用预先训练过的模型强大的视觉和时间理解能力. Video-3D LLM [43] 将多视图室内观测作为视频处理并注入3D位置编码,而3DRS [23] 进一步引入了明确的3D代表监督. 尽管这些结构的能力越来越强,而且能够利用丰富的多模式观测,但现有的3D有限责任公司仍然受到强调类别、空间关系和其他粗细监管的数据集的限制[13、5、11]。 因此,他们的理解仍然粗糙,训练信号对细纹物体细节有限,物体小而容易被忽略。

blocks.en: 2.3 Distillation with privileged information
blocks.zh: 2.3 使用特殊信息消化

blocks.en: Knowledge distillation [ 16 ] transfers a teacher’s outputs or representations to a student, while Learning Using Privileged Information [ 31 ] allows the teacher to access additional observations that are unavailable to the deployed student. Generalized distillation [ 25 ] combines these ideas under asymmetric teacher–student observations. In 3D understanding, SAT [ 35 ] uses training-time 2D semantics to improve point-cloud grounding. X-Trans2Cap [ 40 ] transfers 2D appearance knowledge from a multimodal teacher to a point-cloud captioner, while ExCap3D [ 37 ] uses visibility-ranked multiview images and a VLM to construct fine-grained descriptions for training a dedicated captioning model. Vision-OPD [ 39 ] similarly treats target-region crops as privileged visual input and transfers regional perception to the full-image policy through on-policy self-distillation. Lens3D extends this direction with a target-conditioned evidence interface shared across fine-grained object captioning, small-object grounding, and fine-grained object QA. LensUnd selects views by marginal target-surface coverage. LensDistill then uses captions generated from these views to train general 3D LLMs. Supplementary Sections A.3 and A.5 compare view coverage and description quality across different selection strategies.
blocks.zh: 知识分解[16] 将教师的产出或陈述转移给学生,而使用私密信息学习[31] 则允许教师获取部署学生无法获得的额外观察。 一般蒸馏[25]在不对称的老师-学生观察下结合了这些想法. 在3D理解中,SAT [35]使用训练-时间2D语义来改进点-云地平面. X-Trans2Cap [40] 将2D外观知识从多模式老师转移到了点-云字幕器,而ExCap3D [37] 则使用能见度排名多视图图像和VLM来构建精细的描述来训练专用字幕模型. 展望-OPD[39]同样将目标区域的作物视为有特权的视觉投入,并通过政策上的自我消化将区域观念转移至全面形象政策。 Lens3D扩展了这个方向,在精细对象标题,小对象地面,和精细对象QA之间共享了目标有条件的证据接口. 镜头 Und通过边缘目标表面覆盖选择视图. 然后LensDistill使用这些视图生成的字幕来训练一般的3D LLM. 补充部分A.3和A.5对不同选择战略的视野覆盖面和描述质量进行比较。

blocks.en: 3.  Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Lens3D consists of LensUnd, a general target-conditioned understanding pipeline, and LensDistill, an asymmetric privileged-information distillation method. As illustrated in Figure 2 , LensUnd follows a Ground–Focus–Understand scheme. It first uses a 3D LLM to locate the object or region relevant to a language query. The resulting 3D bounding box guides the selection of complementary RGB views, in which the target region is explicitly marked. An external 2D VLM then processes these views according to a task-specific instruction. Through different instructions and output formats, the same evidence collection procedure supports fine-grained object captioning, small-object grounding, and fine-grained object QA. LensDistill then transfers the resulting fine-grained knowledge to a 3D LLM operating on its native inputs. We study this transfer through fine-grained object captioning, using structured, detailed captions as supervision. After distillation, the student generates detailed descriptions without additional view processing or external VLM calls at inference.
blocks.zh: Lens3D由LensUnd(一般目标条件理解管)和Lens Distill(不对称特权信息分馏法)组成. 如图2所示,LensUnd遵循的是Ground-Focus-Understand计划。 它首先使用3D LLM来定位与语言查询相关的对象或区域. 由此产生的3D边框指导选择互补的RGB视图,其中明确标出目标区域. 然后由外部的2D VLM根据任务特定指令处理这些视图. 通过不同的指令和输出格式,同样的证据收集程序支持精细对象标题,小对象地平分,和精细对象QA. 然后,LensDistill将由此产生的精细分量的知识转移给使用其本土输入的3D LLM。 我们通过精细的物体标题来研究这种转移, 使用结构化的详细标题作为监督. 蒸馏后,学生生成详细的描述,无需额外的视图处理或外部VLM调用推论.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem setting
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题设置

blocks.en:
Let an indoor scene be S = { ( I t , D t , Π t ) } t = 1 T , S=\{(I_{t},D_{t},\Pi_{t})\}_{t=1}^{T}, (1) where I t I_{t} , D t D_{t} , and Π t \Pi_{t} denote the RGB image, depth map, and camera parameters of frame t t .
Given a language query q q , a 3D grounder G G predicts an bounding box b b for the relevant object or region. LensUnd constructs target-conditioned visual evidence ℰ b \mathcal{E}_{b} , which an external 2D VLM U U processes under task instruction p p .
LensDistill trains a student f θ f_{\theta} using its native scene input X X , the target center c ⁡ ( b ) c(b) encoded by the <coord> token, and instruction p p : b = G ⁡ ( S , q ) , y ⋆ = U ⁡ ( ℰ b , p ) , y = f θ ​ ( X , c ⁡ ( b ) , p ) . b=G(S,q),\qquad y^{\star}=U(\mathcal{E}_{b},p),\qquad y=f_{\theta}(X,c(b),p). (2) Depth and camera parameters support target visibility estimation, 3D-box projection, and view selection. Following Video-3D LLM and 3DRS, X X comprises subsampled RGB views with depth- and camera-derived 3D positional encodings for their visual tokens. We perform distillation through fine-grained object captioning, using the external VLM’s descriptions as teacher responses y ⋆ y^{\star} . LensUnd also supports small-object grounding and fine-grained object QA by varying p p .

blocks.en: Let 𝒞 \mathcal{C} contain geometrically valid, depth-visible candidate frames. We assign each candidate a quality score s t s_{t} based on projected target completeness, image coverage, centrality, and occlusion estimated through depth consistency. We then unproject its depth pixels, retain 3D points inside b b , and discretize them into an occupied voxel set 𝒱 t \mathcal{V}_{t} . All views use a shared voxel grid with approximately n v = 12 n_{v}=12 cells along the shortest box axis. Thus, 𝒱 t \mathcal{V}_{t} represents observed surfaces within the target region rather than its projected image area.

We call this bounding-box voxel-selection strategy bbox-voxel ; Algorithm 1 gives the complete procedure.

blocks.en: The same evidence selection procedure supports fine-grained object captioning, small-object grounding, and fine-grained object QA through different instructions and output formats. For small-object grounding, the initially grounded region can contain the smaller object of interest. LensUnd therefore accommodates compatible 3D grounders and 2D VLMs without changing the evidence selection procedure. We quantitatively evaluate fine-grained object captioning with Video-3D LLM and 3DRS; Figure 3 illustrates the other two tasks.

blocks.en: 3.4 LensDistill: Asymmetric distillation with privileged information
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 伦斯迪斯蒂尔: 具有特殊信息的不对称蒸馏

blocks.en: LensUnd relies on the full RGB-D sequence, target-conditioned view selection, and an additional 2D VLM call, introducing inference cost when directly deploying. To avoid this cost, we propose LensDistill, an asymmetric teacher–student framework for transferring externally acquired fine-grained knowledge into native 3D LLMs. During training, the teacher accesses privileged target-level evidence, while the student operates on the same observation space used at test time. At inference, the student produces the corresponding fine-grained understanding without privileged evidence or external VLM calls. We perform and validate this transfer paradigm on fine-grained object captioning.
blocks.zh: 镜头 Und依赖于完整的RGB-D序列,目标有条件的视图选择,以及额外的2D VLM呼叫,在直接部署时引入推论成本. 为了避免这一代价,我们建议LensDistill(英语:LensDistill) — — 一个不对称的教师-学生框架 — — 将外部获得的精致知识转移到本地3D LLM。 在培训期间,教师获得特殊目标级证据,而学生则在测试时使用的相同观测空间上工作。 推论,学生在没有特权证据或外部VLM调用的情况下产生相应的精细分辨的理解. 我们在精细的物体标题上 执行和验证这种转移模式。

blocks.en: For a target region represented by a 3D box b b , LensUnd first constructs privileged evidence ℰ b = { I ~ t } t ∈ 𝒮 \mathcal{E}_{b}=\{\widetilde{I}_{t}\}_{t\in\mathcal{S}} , from which an external VLM teacher generates a fine-grained understanding y ⋆ y^{\star} under task instruction p p . The student retains the base 3D LLM’s native scene input X X , the target center c ⁡ ( b ) c(b) encoded by the <coord> token, and instruction p p . The selected, wireframe-marked views are used only to generate teacher supervision. LensDistill thus transfers knowledge acquired from privileged target-level observations rather than matching teacher and student responses under identical inputs.

blocks.en: 4.  Experiments
blocks.zh: 4. 实验

blocks.en: LensUnd demonstrates small-object grounding and fine-grained object QA over focused multiview evidence. Fine-grained object captioning provides the quantitative testbed for establishing the benefit of target-conditioned evidence and LensDistill’s transfer effectiveness across different 3D LLMs.

blocks.en: 4.1 Quantitative evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 定量评价

blocks.en: We construct LensBench to evaluate fine-grained target descriptions against diverse, independent references. It contains 2,068 validation objects from 141 ScanNet validation scenes, with three independent references generated by GPT 5.4 [ 28 ] , Gemini 3 [ 29 ] , and Qwen 3.5 [ 30 ] from views focused using ground-truth boxes. Each reference contains a summary and structured fields for visible parts, materials, and object state; Parts, Materials, and State F1 measure set-token overlap on the corresponding fields. Its scenes do not overlap the 561 ScanNet training scenes used by LensDistill. In a public questionnaire, respondents evaluate 100 randomly sampled objects and separately rate each anonymized reference against the focused views, yielding 300 ratings with a mean of 3.85/4.0 and supporting their use as high-quality silver references.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了Lens Bench 来评价精细的目标描述 而不是不同的独立参考文献 它包含141个ScanNet验证场景的2,068个验证对象,其中由GPT 5.4 [28],双子座3 [29] 和Quen 3.5 [30]生成的三条独立参考文献,取自以地面真实框为焦点的视图. 每个参考文件都包含一个可可见部件、材料和对象状态的概要和结构化字段; 部件、材料和在相应字段上的国家F1计量设置重叠。 它的场景并不与伦斯迪斯蒂尔所使用的561 ScanNet训练场景相重叠. 在一份公开的问卷中,被调查者对100个随机抽取的物体进行评价,并根据重点观点对每个匿名引用进行单独评分,获得300分的评分,平均值为3.85 4.0,并支持将其用作高品质的银色参考.

blocks.en: We evaluate fine-grained descriptions on LensBench and retained native capabilities on the standard ScanNet [ 13 ] benchmarks ScanRefer [ 5 ] , Multi3DRefer [ 41 ] , ScanQA [ 2 ] , and SQA3D [ 26 ] . We report Acc@0.25/0.5 for ScanRefer, F1@0.25/0.5 for Multi3DRefer, CIDEr [ 32 ] for ScanQA, and exact match for SQA3D. Description metrics include token F1 and embedding similarity for summaries and set-token F1 for parts, materials, and state.

blocks.en: We instantiate students with Video-3D LLM [ 43 ] and 3DRS [ 23 ] . For 7,854 objects, LensUnd provides four target-focused views independently to GPT 5.4, Gemini 3, and Qwen 3.5, chosen for their strong general-purpose visual reasoning and complementary model priors; all successful responses are retained, yielding 23,560 structured captions. We jointly fine-tune each student’s main vision–language stack for one epoch, replacing short Scan2Cap descriptions with this supervision while retaining the original grounding and QA data. Students keep their native 32-view inputs. Supplementary Section A.2 gives the complete prompt, data composition, frame-quality definition, and optimization details.
blocks.zh: 我们用视频-3D LLM和3DRS[23]对学生进行即兴表演. 对于7,854个物体, 镜头 Und独立为GPT 5.4,双子座3和Quen 3.5提供四条以目标为主的视角,为它们强大的通用视觉推理和互补模式前作所选择;所有成功的响应都被保留了下来,产生了23,560个结构化标题. 校对:Soup 学生保留原生的32景入声. 补充科 A.2给出了完整的即时,数据组成,帧质量定义,以及优化细节.

blocks.en: The quantitative results in Table 1 show consistent fine-grained description gains for both student architectures. LensUnd also benefits from target-conditioned evidence and stronger VLM capacity, while remaining robust to predicted target boxes. In a blind user study on 100 objects using a four-point scale, LensDistill raises the mean rating from 1.92 to 3.86 for 3DRS and from 1.88 to 3.71 for Video-3D LLM, confirming substantial improvements in perceived description quality.
blocks.zh: 表1中的定量结果显示了两种学生建筑的一贯精细描述收益. 镜头 不受约束还得益于目标有条件的证据和更强的VLM能力,同时坚挺到预测的目标框. 在一项使用四分制对100个物体的盲目用户研究中,Lens Distill将3DRS的平均值从1.92提高到3.86,而Video-3D LLM的平均值从1.88提高到3.71,这证实了感知到的描述质量有了很大的改善.

blocks.en: Supplementary Table 6 reports the complete LensBench results. Wireframe marking contributes to performance, increasing Summary F1 from 0.263 to 0.370 with our selected views. With ground-truth boxes, four views, projected wireframes, and the same VLM, our bbox-voxel frame selection achieves a Summary F1 of 0.445, outperforming ExCap3D’s visibility ranking (0.436) and Video-3D LLM’s greedy selection used in object-level (0.353). Increasing temporal uniform sampling from 4 to 32 views yields only marginal gains, possibly since the additional views provide little target-relevant evidence. Using predicted boxes retains at least 97.5% of the performance obtained with ground-truth boxes across the main metrics. Scaling the VLM from 2B to 8B further improves Summary F1 from 0.445 to 0.485 and Attr. Mean from 0.397 to 0.528. The corresponding gains for parts, materials, and states are 22.2, 9.4, and 7.6 percentage points, respectively.
blocks.zh: 补充表6报告了全部Lens Bench结果。 线框标记有助于性能,随着我们选定的观点,摘要F1从0.263增加到0.370。 有了地上真相框,四面相框,投影线框,同为VLM,我们的box-voxel帧选择实现0.445的Summer F1,优于ExCap3D的能见度排名(0.436)和Video-3D LLM在对象级别中使用的贪婪选择(0.353). 将时间统一抽样从4个到32个观点只能产生微小收益,可能是因为其他观点很少提供目标相关证据。 使用预测的盒子保留了至少97.5%的性能,通过主要指标的地面真实盒获得。 将VLM从2B扩展至8B进一步将摘要F1从0.445改进为0.485和Attr. 平均值从0.397到0.528。 零件、材料和状态的相应收益分别为22.2分、9.4分和7.6分。

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that, under its detailed-captioning instantiation, LensDistill enhances the fine-grained description capability that is limited in the base models while preserving, and in some cases improving, their original grounding and question-answering performance. The gains are most apparent in grounding. Table 3 further shows that both backbones improve at both thresholds when same-class distractors are present, whereas unique-instance scores change by at most 0.54 points. This concentration of gains in challenging multi-instance scenes suggests that detailed-caption supervision improves instance discrimination while retaining standard grounding performance.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,LensDistill在其详细封装即时描述下,增强了基础模型中受限的精细描述能力,同时保留并在某些情况下改进了原始地基和问答性能. 这些成果在基础建设方面最为明显。 表3还显示,当存在同级分流器时,两根主干线在两个阈值上都有所改进,而独有的分数则最多会变化0.54分. 将收益集中在挑战多场场景上表明,详细封装监督在保持标准的基础性表现的同时,会改善实例歧视。

blocks.en: 4.2 Qualitative evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 定性评价

blocks.en: Beyond fine-grained object captioning, LensUnd supports small-object grounding and fine-grained object QA through task-specific instructions over focused multiview evidence. For small-object grounding, it focuses on a coarse anchor region, localizes a queried object in the selected views, and aggregates the unprojected observations into a 3D box. For fine-grained object QA, the external VLM reasons over the focused evidence to answer questions about object presence, appearance, and manipulation. Figures 3 and 4 present representative examples of grounding and QA.
blocks.zh: 除了细纹对象标题外,LensUnd通过任务特定指令支持小对象地平面和细纹对象QA,而不是焦点多视图证据. 对于小对象打地,它侧重于粗糙的锚地区域,将所选视图中的被询问对象本地化,并将未预测的观测结果汇总为3D框. 对于细纹对象QA,外部的VLM理由在焦点证据之上,用来回答关于物体存在,外观,和被操纵的问题. 图3和图4为确定理由和质量保证的典型例子。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : More qualitative results with LensUnd. Examples across multiple scenes demonstrate LensUnd’s ability to handle varied fine-grained 3D understanding scenarios.
blocks.zh: 图4:与LensUnd取得更高质量的成果。 多场景的例子表明LensUnd有能力处理各种精细的3D理解方案。

blocks.en: 4.3 Evidence analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 证据分析

blocks.en: We use two complementary tests to establish that LensDistill uses target-level visual evidence. Masking the target region causes a substantial performance drop: Summary F1 decreases from 0.489 to 0.369, Overall F1 from 0.470 to 0.337, and Summary Sem. from 0.753 to 0.560. In the final four layers, the top 5% of image patches receive 35.0% of answer-token attention on average, seven times the uniform expectation, while attention alignment with the projected target reaches 8.96 times the uniform expectation. Together, these results show that LensDistill retrieves target appearance from native multiview observations rather than relying only on language patterns or coordinate priors. Supplementary Section A.4 provides the masking results, full protocol, and layer-wise analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个补充测试来确定LensDistill使用目标层面的视觉证据. 掩盖目标区域导致业绩大幅下降: F1摘要从0.489减至0.369,F1总数从0.470减至0.337,Sem摘要从0.753减至0.560。 在最后的四层中,前5%的图像补丁平均得到35.0%的答题关注,是统一期待的7倍,而注意力与预计目标相匹配则达到统一期待的8.96倍. 这些结果表明,LensDistill从本土多视图观测中检索到目标外观,而不是仅仅依赖语言模式或协调前科. 补充部分A.4提供遮掩结果、完整的协议和分层分析。

blocks.en: 5.  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 结论

blocks.en: We presented Lens3D, a framework that combines target-conditioned visual foveation with capability transfer for fine-grained 3D understanding. LensUnd constructs focused multiview evidence that enables an external VLM to supplement existing 3D LLMs, while LensDistill transfers the acquired knowledge back into 3D LLMs operating on their native inputs. Experiments with two representative 3D LLMs show that caption-based LensDistill substantially improves fine-grained object descriptions while maintaining their native grounding and question-answering capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Lens3D,这个框架将目标条件可视化与能力转移相结合,用于精细的3D理解. 镜头 Und构造了有焦点的多视图证据,使外部的VLM能够补充现有的3D LLM,而LensDistill将获得的知识重新转移到3D LLM中,运行在他们的本土输入上. 与两个具有代表性的3D LLMs的实验显示,基于字幕的LensDistill在保持其原生地基和问答能力的同时,大大地改进了精细地标对象描述.
